_source: Captured verbatim from https://beacon.nist.gov/beacon/2.0/chain/2/pulse/{index} and /beacon/2.0/certificate/{certificateId} on 2026-10-01 (UTC). Pulse objects are the API's `pulse` member, unmodified. Nothing in this file is computed by the lab.

skiplist._how: Walked backward from the anchor, at each step following the listValues link (previous/hour/day/month/year) that lands closest to the target without passing it; each pulse fetched by its own URI. Stored oldest first.
